requirements.text: This is a remote position, but applicants must currently be physically located in the San Francisco Bay Area, California. Applicants residing outside the the San Francisco Bay Area will not be considered for this opening.
Must be 18 years of age or older
Experience programming in at least one general-purpose language, such as Java, Python, C++, C#, Go, Rust, or TypeScript
Understanding of data structures, basic algorithms, and/or object-oriented programming
Bachelor's degree completed or in progress in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related STEM field
Ability to communicate effectively in a technical work environment
Currently authorized to work in the United States without employer-sponsored immigration support now or in the future

The ideal candidate has a foundation in computer science, experience programming in at least one general-purpose language, and a working understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software design principles.
